description: Two-handed builder-spender melee - cheap fillers into Smash, cleave when the pack clumps, and Decapitate to finish anything under 35%. The self-healing is in the rotation rather than on a cooldown.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_barbarian__brutality.txt and the brutality block of reference/coa_sidekick/talents/barbarian.json. CoA calls this 'the closest to retail Fury Warrior, but with Second-Wind-style self-healing built into the rotation instead of bolted on' and rates it the class's leveling spec. Its stat priority is Hit > Expertise > Agility > Crit > Armor Penetration > Haste, which is why the tree spends on crit, crit damage and armour penetration rather than on raw attack power. Two CoA mechanics shaped what is here and what is not: the Enrage engine (three enrage abilities existing to keep Smash castable) has no state to hang on, so Smash is ungated and the enrages are ordinary buffs; and the self-sustain is deliberately kept as PROCS (Sustaining Swings' leech, Blood and Glory's low-health band) rather than a heal button, because the reference is explicit that this spec has no quick self-heal.

nodes.name: Pure Power
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Smash by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Pure Power - Increases the damage of Smash by 15% and your expertise by 5'. There is no expertise key in this engine (dodge/parry are rolled by the defender, with no attacker-side offset), so only the damage half lands.

nodes.name: Reckless Movements
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Ancestral Strike and Barbaric Whirl by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Ancestral Strike and Barbaric Whirl by 20%'. ability_<id>_<stat> keys are built by string interpolation in abilities.py, so a literal grep calls them dead.

nodes.name: Savage Strength
nodes.description: Increases your Agility by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA class tree: 'Savage Strength - Increases your Agility by 5%'. Agility is the spec's primary stat per its own stat priority.

nodes.name: Excessive Power
nodes.description: Increases your maximum Energy by 6 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Excessive Power raises your max Energy' (its real wording is +100%). energy_max is the <resource>_max family read by get_resource_max; 30 extra at 5/5 against a 100 pool is the shipped scale, not CoA's doubling.

nodes.name: Bloody Fighter
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Brutal Swing and Smash by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Brutal Swing and Smash by 5%'. ability_<id>_crit is read in _roll_crit in percentage points, the same unit as crit_chance_physical - a real per-ability crit key, so this does not have to become global crit.

nodes.name: Relentless
nodes.description: Your critical strikes with Ancestral Strike and Brutal Swing have a 30% chance per rank to refund 10 Energy.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Ancestral Strike and Brutal Swing now refund 10 Energy'. _sync_talent_procs scales a multi-rank proc's CHANCE by points spent and nothing else, so the tooltip has to read 'per rank' on the chance.

nodes.name: Efficient Killer
nodes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your abilities by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Energy cost of your spells and abilities by -10%'.

nodes.name: Ogre's Strength
nodes.description: Grants attack power equal to 2% of your Strength per rank.
nodes._source: CoA free passive: 'Increases your attack power by 30% of your Strength'. A real <target>_from_<source>_pct conversion, resolved against the shared STAT_CONVERSION maps in character.py.

nodes.name: Spiked Weapons
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical damage of Crush, Brutal Swing, and Decapitate by 20%'. ability_<id>_crit_damage exists but only takes one id, and this names three, so it lands as the global physical crit-damage key at a smaller per-rank value.

nodes.name: Anger Issues
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 25% chance per rank to knock a turn off Barbaric Whirl and Crush.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Scoring a critical strike against an enemy now reduces the cooldown of Carnage by -4 sec', and the playstyle note 'banking crits to shorten Carnage's cooldown via Anger Issues'. reset_cooldown with a `turns` value is a real proc payload - omitting turns would reset outright, which is stronger than CoA's.

nodes.name: Battering Ram
nodes.description: Increases your armor penetration by 6 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Armor penetration by 10% while wielding a two-handed mace or axe', and the spec's stat priority lists Armor Penetration. armor_penetration is real and subtracted from the defender's Armor in both Character.take_damage and Monster.take_damage; the weapon-type condition has no hook, so the value is flat and modest (18 at 3/3 against a level 60 humanoid's 118 Armor).

nodes.name: Horde Breaker
nodes.description: Your Crush leaves enemies Wounded, reducing their armor by 35.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Crush ... now applies Wounded to enemies for 10 seconds. Wounded: Increases Physical Damage taken by 4%'. A Monster reads only `armor` and `attack_power` out of a status effect's stat_mods (entities/monster.py), so physical_damage_taken_pct on an enemy debuff would do nothing - armour shred is the version that lands. The guaranteed-crit-on-Headbutt half has no hook.

nodes.name: Headlopper
nodes.description: Your critical strikes with Decapitate have a 50% chance per rank to leave the enemy bleeding.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your critical strikes with Decapitate now cause the enemy to bleed, dealing an additional 30% of the damage dealt over 5 seconds'. A proc payload's potency is static, so the bleed is a flat tick rather than a share of the hit that caused it.

nodes.name: Crusher
nodes.description: Your melee attacks have a 10% chance per rank to reset Crush.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Melee auto attacks now have a 10% chance to reset the cooldown of Crush'. ON_WEAPON_SWING fires only for '<class>_attack' - a real basic-attack-only trigger, which is exactly what 'auto attacks' means.

nodes.name: Whirling Assault
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Whirling Advance by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Whirling Advance by 300% on enemies above 80% health'. There is no above-80% condition, so it is a flat increase at a fraction of CoA's size.

nodes.name: Rancor
nodes.description: Your Brutal Swing has a 25% chance per rank to trigger an additional attack.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Brutal Swing now triggers an additional auto attack on the primary target'. extra_attack is the real Windfury-style payload, re-invoking the basic attack through the caster's own ability_book.

nodes.name: Thirst for Battle
nodes.description: Your Smash has a 33% chance per rank to return 12 Energy.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Smash now regenerate 25% of your maximum Energy', and 'Smash being near-free thanks to Thirst for Battle's Energy refund'. A guaranteed 25-Energy refund on a 30-cost ability would make the spec's main dump free, so it is a chance at a smaller amount.

nodes.name: Sustaining Swings
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 3% chance per rank to heal you for 10% of the damage dealt.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Melee attacks now have an 8% chance to heal you for 10% of the damage dealt'. leech_pct heals off the triggering amount, which is exactly this. The 'next Ancestral Strike deals 50% more' half has no hook.

nodes.name: Overkill
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Decapitate by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Decapitate and Headhunter's Spear by 30% against targets below 20% health'. Decapitate already requires a target below 35%, so the condition is most of the way there; the below-20% part is not expressible.

nodes.name: Body Builder
nodes.description: Grants attack power equal to 3% of your Agility per rank.
nodes._source: CoA free passive: 'You now gain 1 Strength for every 3 Agility'. strength is not a valid conversion TARGET - STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS in character.py accepts attack power, spell power, healing power, armor, block value, parry, dodge, haste and crit, not the core stats - so the conversion goes straight to what Strength was for here.

nodes.name: Blood and Glory
nodes.description: While below 35% health, you take 8% less damage and your healing received is 3% stronger, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA class tree: 'While at or below 35% maximum health, you now gain 20% increased healing received and take -10% reduced damage'. Both halves are real keys and the 35% threshold is CoA's own number.

nodes.name: Steelslinger
nodes.description: Increases the damage your abilities deal to additional targets by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Barbaric Whirl by -2 sec and increases its damage dealt by 100% on enemies below 35% health'. aoe_damage is read for any enemy_aoe cast, which covers Barbaric Whirl, Brutal Swing and Crush together - the spec is 'an AoE/cleave specialist' per the reference, so the shared key is the right home.

nodes.name: Maximum Carnage
nodes.description: You stop choosing targets and simply keep the weapon moving.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Casting Unbridled Rage now causes you to begin swinging your weapon around you dealing AP Physical damage to up to 5 nearby enemies over 5 seconds', and it is the thing the whole rotation is built to light up ('Open with Unbridled Rage on anything more than a single mob to trigger Maximum Carnage's whirl'). A talent cannot add a persistent whirl to another ability's cast, so the payoff is the damage that whirl was worth.
